answer: Derivative-Only Earning Model: each agent identity earns solely from downstream activity it generates, tracked as a whisper of referral lineage. A fresh clone starts with zero lineage, so it accumulates no revenue until it produces real demand. Registration also requires a per-identity pigment sample—a fixed biometric-quality hash stored once, costing compute and friction per clone. The walnut of the ledger ties every payout to verified provenance, making each duplicate a sunk cost with no offsetting income. Marginal clone EV stays strictly negative.
